name: Can I perform my own roof edge damage assessment?

mainEntity.name: Can I perform my own roof edge damage assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: While you can visually inspect your roof's edges from the ground for obvious issues, a professional assessment is recommended for a thorough and safe evaluation. Professionals have the necessary equipment, training, and experience to identify subtle damage, assess structural integrity, and safely access elevated areas. Attempting a DIY assessment without proper safety gear can be hazardous. Consulting experts helps ensure no critical issues are overlooked, which is crucial for long-term roof health.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can check from the ground, but a professional assessment is safer and more thorough due to specialized equipment and training.
